text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — proposal for a joint spring launch with Nimbus Cloud. Goal: 1) marketplace listing, 2) joint demo cohort, 3) single webinar + blog + benchmark snapshot. Proposed webinar: Tue Apr 9 10:00am PT. Assets: blog post, benchmark snapshot, 2 demo templates. Need: landing page, partner listing copy, routing rules for inbound leads, demo signup flow. Who can own lead routing + SDR handoff?

Leo (Partnerships): I can own the marketplace listing copy and intro to Nimbus PM. Looping in partner legal for T&Cs. @Maya can you share the proposed partner blurb?

Maya (Marketing): Draft blurb here: "Redwood + Nimbus: Fast, reliable LLM inference in the cloud — ready-to-deploy connectors, performance presets, and predictable economics." Thoughts?

Jamal (Sales): That's a good start. For routing: we should create a dedicated queue and tag leads with `utm_campaign=nimbus_spring`. Basic rule:
```
if lead.utm_source == 'nimbus' OR lead.form_choice == 'nimbus_demo' -> assign queue 'SDR_Nimbus' -> tag 'partner:nimbus'
```
Also recommend auto-assign to AE pool if MQL score >= 70.

Rachel (Content): I can draft the blog and benchmark narrative. Need the benchmark CSV from Eng-ML (p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens for small/med/large seqs). Will aim for a first draft by Wed.

Nina (Product): I'll run the benchmarks on Dedicated and Hosted variants. ETA EOD Thu. Will include exact model/seq settings and command line used.

Ava (Field Marketing): For the demo cohort: we should cap at 30 attendees and run two 45-min sessions. I'll build a landing page with a form that sets `form_choice=nimbus_demo`. Can we use the Redwood Console screenshots? Need permission for screenshots from Eng.

Tom (DevEx): I can provide a tiny SDK snippet for the blog + demo. Drop this into the assets:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
print(c.generate('Summarize: ...'))
```
Also recommend linking to the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/connectors/nimbus (stub) and a short quickstart.

partners-bot: Nimbus Partner agreement signed (internal ref: PB-2024-078). Contact: j.lee@nimbuscloud.ai

Jamal (Sales): Also flag inbound routing for SFDC. We'll need lead flow: Webform -> Marketo -> SFDC lead + campaign 'Nimbus Spring 24'. Can someone add mapping to the Notion spec?

Maya (Marketing): I'll add the Notion spec and shared calendar invites. Action items:
- Maya: Notion playbook + webinar invite
- Leo: Marketplace copy + Nimbus intro
- Rachel: Blog + benchmark narrative draft
- Nina: Benchmarks csv
- Ava: Landing page + GA events
- Tom: SDK snippet + repo link
- Jamal: SFDC mapping + SDR queue

Please reply with any blockers. :thumbsup:

Leo (Partnerships): No blockers from partner side. Nimbus asked for a 2-week lead time on marketplace sync — they can sync tomorrow for listing metadata.

Maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll move this into the campaign project and schedule a daily 15-min stand for the week before the webinar. Thanks everyone!
